## Overview

LRPLF07 is a **level-factors** model for CELF basic concepts (`celf`): what is associated with the score *level* at each of the four timepoints (Beta-Binomial logit, child random intercept; no own baseline).

_Causal labelling + level-model crossover caveat._ Every non-randomised coefficient is an **adjusted association** under the DAG. The group effect is `group x time`, parameterised as the covariate-adjusted arm gap at t1 (`arm_gap_t1`, a pre-randomisation *balance* quantity, never an effect) plus the change in that gap at each later wave (`d_grp_time[t]`; #552): after t2 the waitlist crosses over, so the **clean randomised contrast lives only at t2** — the t2 change `d_grp_time[t2]`, a difference-in-differences of adjusted levels, labelled *causal*; the t3/t4 changes are randomised early-start-versus-delayed-start schedule contrasts, not treated-versus-untreated effects, and the per-wave gaps `b_grp_time[t] = arm_gap_t1 + d_grp_time[t]` are kept as a derived levels view. SES excluded (non-DAG / redundant).

## Model

Beta-Binomial$(N, \mu\kappa, (1-\mu)\kappa)$ on the level count, $N = 18$, with
$\operatorname{logit}\mu_{t} = \alpha + \alpha_{\text{time}[t]} + b_{\text{grp}[t]}\text{group} + \gamma_A A_{\text{std},t} + g_{\text{ability}[t]}z(\text{blocks}) + \gamma_{\text{grp\_ability}}\,\text{group}\,z(\text{blocks}) + u_{\text{child}}$.
